title: Just received a settlement? Here are 5 smart ways to use the money.
title_zh: 刚刚收到和解金？这里有 5 种明智的使用这笔钱的方法。
summary: Receiving a settlement payment can be a great opportunity to set yourself up for financial success. Here are 5 ways to put that money to good use.
summary_zh: 收到和解付款可能是为自己取得财务成功做好准备的绝佳机会。以下是充分利用这笔钱的 5 种方法。

title: Nvidia's revenue forecast lifts Wall Street; investors eye the Fed's Warsh
title_zh: 英伟达的营收预测提振华尔街；投资者关注美联储的沃什
summary: By Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant and Saeed Azhar Aug 27 (Reuters) - The tech-heavy Nasdaq outperformed peers on Thursday after Nvidia's blockbuster results reaffirmed the strength of the AI boom and
summary_zh: 作者：Purvi Agarwal、Niket Nishant 和 Saeed Azhar 8 月 27 日（路透社）——周四，在 Nvidia 的重磅业绩再次证实了人工智能热潮的力量和影响之后，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数跑赢了同业。

title: Major tech companies call for defensive surge to defeat AI-driven hacks
title_zh: 大型科技公司呼吁加强防御以击败人工智能驱动的黑客攻击
summary: By Raphael Satter WASHINGTON, Aug 27 (Reuters) - Major tech companies including OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, Alphabet, and Amazon are calling for a society-wide defensive surge to defeat what they
summary_zh: 作者：Raphael Satter 华盛顿，8 月 27 日（路透社）——OpenAI、Anthropic、微软、Alphabet 和亚马逊等主要科技公司呼吁全社会加强防御，以击败他们所面临的威胁。

title: Google agrees to settle UK app developers' lawsuit for $353 million
title_zh: 谷歌同意以 3.53 亿美元和解英国应用开发商诉讼
summary: LONDON, Aug 27 (Reuters) - Google has agreed to settle a mass London lawsuit brought on behalf of app developers for £260 million ($353.21 million), according to a deal published on Thursday.
summary_zh: 路透伦敦 8 月 27 日 - 根据周四公布的协议，谷歌已同意以 2.6 亿英镑（3.5321 亿美元）和解代表应用开发商在伦敦提起的大规模诉讼。

title: Meta settlement opens new front in global fight over social media harm
title_zh: 元结算为全球应对社交媒体危害的斗争开辟了新战线
summary: SYDNEY/MANILA/BRUSSELS, Aug 27 (Reuters) - Meta's move to restrict teenagers' use of social media in the U. shows companies have tools to better protect young people online, Australian officials said on Thursday, while in the Philippines, an official said the U.
summary_zh: 路透悉尼/马尼拉/布鲁塞尔8月27日 - 澳大利亚官员周四表示，Meta在美国限制青少年使用社交媒体的举措表明公司拥有更好地保护青少年上网的工具，而菲律宾的一名官员则表示，美国公司拥有更好的工具来保护青少年上网。

title: How tokenization benefits SpaceX stock 'without taking crypto risk'
title_zh: 代币化如何在“不承担加密风险”的情况下让 SpaceX 股票受益
summary: Dialectic founder Ryan Zurrer comes on Market Catalysts to discuss the opportunities that tokenized assets present compared to traditional stocks, and the advantages this is giving companies like Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPCX).
summary_zh: Dialectic 创始人 Ryan Zurrer 在 Market Catalysts 上讨论了代币化资产与传统股票相比所带来的机遇，以及这给埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX (SPCX) 等公司带来的优势。

title: Here are the launches John Ternus needs to nail as Apple's next CEO
title_zh: 以下是约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 作为苹果下一任首席执行官需要推出的产品
summary: Market Catalyst's Brooke DiPalma talks with TECHnalysis Research President Bob O'Donnell about the biggest hardware changes and AI integrations that could be coming to Apple as John Ternus prepares to take the reins from CEO Tim Cook on Sept. 1.
summary_zh: Market Catalyst 的布鲁克·迪帕尔玛 (Brooke DiPalma) 与 TECHnaanalysis Research 总裁鲍勃·奥唐纳 (Bob O'Donnell) 讨论了随着约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 准备于 9 月 1 日从首席执行官...

title: Why Nvidia is still a buy after earnings
title_zh: 为什么英伟达在财报公布后仍值得买入
summary: Laffer Tengler Investments CEO & CIO Nancy Tengler joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to break down what Nvidia's (NVDA) latest earnings say about the chipmaker's outlook and why she remains bullish on the stock.
summary_zh: Laffer Tengler Investments 首席执行官兼首席信息官 Nancy Tengler 与雅虎财经执行编辑 Brian Sozzi 一起详细分析了英伟达 (NVDA) 最新财报对这家芯片制造商前景的看法，以及她为何仍然看好该股。

title: The US is holding itself back in AI race as admin. weighs semiconductor tariffs
title_zh: 作为管理者，美国在人工智能竞赛中表现不佳。权衡半导体关税
summary: The Trump administration is weighing options for a new round of tariffs on semiconductors, according to POLITICO reporting.
summary_zh: 据 POLITICO 报道，特朗普政府正在权衡新一轮半导体关税的选择。
